Raj: DeployBot fired lease-warning for migration mig_5099 during multi-shard merge at 04:12 UTC. Immediate attention.
DeployBot: [deploybot] LEASE_WARN mig_5099 shard=shard-22 inflight=20/24 renew_fail=2
Mei: seeing lock contention on tenant_meta for shard-22. If we keep going, leases may drop -> rollback.
Tomas: can we do a narrow pause on affected tenant ranges instead of full migration pause?
Ingrid: yes, runbook suggests selective pause + KV snapshot then attempt handoff. runbook: https://confluence.redwood/internal/runbooks/migrations#mig_5099
Raj: decision: selective pause tenants 2100-2140, snapshot, then try handoff to standby-worker-4. If handoff fails -> cancel and rollback those tenants.
Mei: executing selective pause: ```deploybot pause mig_5099 --tenants 2100-2140 --actor mei --reason "lease warn"```
DeployBot: [deploybot] SELECTIVE_PAUSE_ACK mig_5099 tenants=2100-2140 by mei at 5001112230
PagerBot: Note: pausing may extend maintenance window; notify accounts if >10m :bell:
Tomas: starting KV snapshot hook now. ETA ~50s. tagging in runbook.
DeployBot: snapshot_status mig_5099 tenants=2100-2140 status=done checksum=sha256:ab12
Ingrid: snapshot OK. initiating handoff: ```deploybot handoff mig_5099 --to standby-worker-4 --tenant-range 2100-2140 --actor ingrid```
DeployBot: HANDOFF_OK mig_5099 new_owner=standby-worker-4 latency_spike=1.4s
Raj: resuming at 20% ratecap, pinned migration tool to tag infra/mig-release-1.14.0 for consistency.
ReleaseBot: [releasebot] NOTE_PINNED mig_5099 tag=infra/mig-release-1.14.0 by raj
Mei: monitoring shows inflight down to 6 and locks stable. Will abort and rollback if renew_fail >=2 again.
Tomas: adding brief note to release notes: "mig_5099: selective pause + snapshot + standby handoff; resumed at reduced rate; pinned infra/mig-release-1.14.0"
Raj: thanks all. we'll keep thread open for 15m then close if stable. If rollback needed, escalate to oncall and notify sales for impacted accounts. :thumbsup:
